people.name: Parvaim
people.line: A place from which Solomon obtained gold

translations.web: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.
translations.bsb: He adorned the temple with precious stones for beauty, and its gold was from Parvaim.
translations.kjv: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
translations.asv: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
